text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's it for the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And... I lost.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Trainer? I...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will win the next one.

Biwa Hayahide put everything on the
line for the
Kikuka Sho. But now that it's
over, things feel a
little different than
usual.

As soon as we get back to the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hiii! Hey, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we didn't really get a chance to
talk after
the concert, so I brought
Taishin with me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I gotta say, you looked a lot scarier out
there
today than you ever have. I mean,
like... seriously
scary.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But I'm gonna keep getting better and
better, so
you'd better watch out for me!
Yeeeaaah! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Does she ever think about anyone other
than
herself?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I do understand what she means.
It was
like we finally saw your full
abilities out there
today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, have you decided on your next
race yet?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good question. Well, since we finished
all the
Classic Triple Crown races, the
next one available
after winter is...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. It's a prestigious race in Kyoto,
and I
really want to compete with elite
racers there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to win it if I want to be called
the best of
my generation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Good luck with that. I'll be there too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And I'll be there to win. Later.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I guess Taishin has a selfish side to her
too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But it's natural that she'd want to win.
Hehe, I'm
just glad to have finally
caught up to Taishin and
Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You heard them, Trainer! We'd better go
at this
next one with the same energy!

It's an utter relief seeing how much
brighter her
smile is than before.
